question: What act of sprinkling should accompany the recollection of the visualized figure?
premises: The figure is associated with milk-water imagery.
The figure is being sprinkled by all.
The practitioner should recollect this scene.
inference: The meditator should recollect the figure as being sprinkled by all with milk-water.
uncertainties: The token kṣīrodavi(śe appears incomplete or corrupt in transmission.
plain_english: One should recollect him as being sprinkled by all with milk-water.
